svg.title: Aspergillus under the microscope
svg.desc: Magnified Aspergillus: a stalk with a foot cell ends in a swollen round vesicle covered in flask-shaped phialides, each carrying a radiating chain of round conidia. Inset: a yellow-green colony and a black colony, as colour varies by species.
svg.text: CARSI · Level 2 Mould Remediation · magnified, not to scale
